source_caption_text:
Best Audi advertisement ever 😂⁉️

“Audi” is the breakout single from Florida rapper Smokepurpp, released in 2017, and produced by Ronny J. Built around distorted bass, minimal production, and explosive energy, the track quickly became one of the defining songs of the SoundCloud rap era.

The song’s repetitive hook, wild ad-libs, and hypnotic production gave it an instantly recognizable sound. Rather than relying on complex songwriting, Smokepurpp kept the focus on raw energy and a beat designed to hit hard, perfectly capturing the chaotic feel of late-2010s underground rap.

Nearly a decade later, “Audi” remains a major time capsule of that era. Its success helped push Smokepurpp further into the mainstream and cemented Ronny J’s blown-out production style as a defining sound of the South Florida scene.
